todos.task: Analyze the existing monolithic codebase to identify independent components and potential microservices
Decompose the codebase into smaller, loosely-coupled modules based on domain-driven design principles
Design a high-level architecture for the microservices, including service boundaries and communication protocols
Implement each microservice as a separate Python application, using a framework such as Flask or Django
Develop a service discovery mechanism and implement inter-service communication using APIs or message queues
Test and deploy the microservices, using containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
